evidence_spans: connects your online and offline marketing to improve speed, efficiency, personalization, and reporting
by integrating with other powerful technologies from Adobe Experience Cloud and Creative Cloud.

blind.rationale: The description presents campaign software that connects online and offline marketing and integrates with other technologies for reporting, personalization, and efficiency; these are conventional marketing functions without an affirmative AI signal.
evidence_spans: connects your online and offline marketing

records.parent_concerns: Address whether described integration and reporting meaningfully support conventional offering; personalization alone need not imply AI, but thinness cannot be ignored.

packet.description:
Account-based experience — ABX — reinvents ABM around the customer experience.

Inject Account Intelligence into every step of the B2B buyer journey and orchestrate every action across marketing and sales. That’s Smarter GTM.

The Engagement Platform is a single pane of glass that connects every source of intelligence and insight — and every sales and marketing play — so you spot opportunities earlier, engage with them more intelligently, and close deals faster.

labeler.ai_type_rationale: Cross-channel orchestration across marketing and sales is described as the conventional core and would remain without the described intelligence layer. Whether the intelligence is core or an enhancement is unresolved, so enabled is a weak forced subtype.

connects every source of intelligence and insight
ai_type_evidence_spans: orchestrate every action across marketing and sales
reinvents ABM around the customer experience

evidence_spans: orchestrate every action across marketing and sales

records.parent_concerns: Address Account Intelligence and connected intelligence sources: does text establish conventional orchestration or unresolved included AI-dependent functionality? Do not infer mechanism.

packet.description:
Intent HQ enables consumer brands to gain actionable insight on their customers. Intent HQ looks at the people behind the data to assist businesses to move from  customer centric  to  human centric  view; enabling to know who to market to, creating more helpful service interactions, shaping strategy and predicting customer behaviour.

The Platform that provides you with the following capabilities:
The ingestion and storage of your event level customer data, organized by individual.
A linear scale, configuration driven system to compute profiles in near real-time as data changes, allowing you to respond to customer changes on demand.
A collaborative toolset for your data scientists to safely automate and run complex tasks, including data sampling and feature generation on a production dataset.
The ability to host applications that  Know, Infer and Predict  customer attributes and behaviors from patterns in your data and easily take action on them.
APIs to orchestrate data to other business applications, enabling hyper-personalized experiences across all customer touch points.
An Insight Explorer that provides the ability to ask 'train of thought  questions on how customer behavior affects your core KPIs, and easily generate audiences based on this insight.
Compliance with applicable processor privacy regulations required for customer data processing, storage, retrieval and deletion, and managed via a comprehensive set of APIs for control of your customers' data.

labeler.rationale: Describes predicting customer behaviour and hosted applications that infer and predict customer attributes and behaviors from patterns in your data, supported by data-scientist tooling including feature generation. The text establishes learned or statistical prediction models as a product function, so the binary is supported.
labeler.ai_type_rationale: Ingestion and storage of event-level customer data, profile computation and APIs are described as the conventional data-platform core. Whether the predictive applications are core or optional is unclear, so enabled is a weak forced subtype.
evidence_spans: predicting customer behaviour
customer attributes and behaviors from patterns in your data
including data sampling and feature generation on a production dataset
ai_type_evidence_spans: The ingestion and storage of your event level customer data, organized by individual.
APIs to orchestrate data to other business applications

blind.rationale: The description clearly covers customer-data ingestion, profiles, APIs, and audience generation, but its infer-and-predict applications and feature generation do not establish whether the mechanism is AI-dependent.
evidence_spans: The ability to host applications that  Know, Infer and Predict  customer attributes and behaviors from patterns in your data and easily take action on them.

records.parent_concerns: Labeler claims learned/statistical prediction models are established, but source does not explicitly state learned models. Recheck inference/prediction from patterns, feature generation, data-science toolkit and host-app inclusion; keep binary/subtype uncertainty separate.
